BIG CAVEATS for a bot: claim pays only msg.sender's OWN accrual (must stake >= 0.01 stETH first; 14d claim lock after stake and after claim, 7d withdraw lock), reward is a MOR OFT mint landing on the MOR chain (Base/Arbitrum) not native/USDC on ethereum; UserStaked events 0 in 7d (activity thin since Mor 2.0 UI moved to L2). Nobody sweeps for others (claimFor needs the staker's whitelist) so no keeper-style fee, and the farm bot would itself be the staker.
